_help: Phase 16 (2026-10-18): the old lines, kept out of the game. Their art stays in game/art/next/billionaires as the part library. To bring one back, move its file to game/data/lines/ and add its id to game/data/index.json.
_pools: Roster track RO-1 (2026-10-23): pools.json: the 45 wild pools of the old world (every pool but hedgerow, as they were before RO-1, sea and badlands included), kept for the parked places. The game's pools are one per biome in game/data/pools.json, plus hedgerow.
_world: Roguelite track RL-5 (2026-10-21): the old world outside the hub, kept out of the game and read only by the Studio (its Legacy section); index.json lists it in the game data’s layout. locations.json: the 48 places in their old order without Copperleaf, so a place’s old node below 46 is its number here, and old nodes 47 and 48 (Hedgerow Lane, Pearlantis) are 46 and 47. maps/: their maps. roads.json: all 57 roads between them, Route 1 to Copperleaf included. trainers/: the 39 trainers who stood on them (a trainer’s node is its number in locations.json here). story.json: the before-cass test preset. The eight badge leaders stayed in game/data/trainers as mini-bosses (miniboss: true, no node); arenas says where each stood. To bring a map back, use the Studio’s Legacy section (Copy into game): it comes in as a scene of its own, without its place or its roads.
